patch.value: The gantt export alias silently drops out of the preflight override's scope and nothing binds the scope to the registered commands

Scoping registerPreflight to a command list narrows which commands the override runs for. The scope listed only the registered gantt command, but the runtime also derives a gantt export command from the exporter registration, and the previously global override covered that alias by accident. Today the override is advertisement-only (empty delta; the real data-sanity gate is runDataSanityGate called directly by the command and exporter handlers), so nothing behaviorally broke — which is exactly why nothing noticed. The moment the override ever gains enforcement, the export alias would silently bypass it. Worse, nothing binds the scope list to the registered command surface, so the two can drift apart again unnoticed. Fix: add gantt export to the scope, and bind the scope to activation.registrations.commands with a set-equality test that fails the moment either side drifts.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Manifest-vs-scope audit (the check CodeRabbit asked for on pm-linear #67). Commands pm-gantt-chart declares: gantt (registerCommand) and gantt export (the command the runtime derives from the registerExporter("gantt") registration — visible in activation.registrations.commands). Scope after PR #59: gantt only. Diff: gantt export was covered by the previously GLOBAL override by accident and is not covered by the scoped form — a regression by the audit rule, restored in this change. No enforcement was lost today because the override is a pure no-op (empty delta; the real gate is runDataSanityGate, called directly in both the gantt command handler and the gantt export exporter handler), but the scope entry keeps the alias inside the override the moment it ever gains enforcement. A set-equality test now binds the scope to activation.registrations.commands in both directions.

value.note: Asserts the preflight override is scoped to exactly [gantt, gantt export] and binds the scope to activation.registrations.commands with set equality in both directions plus assertCommandContract per scoped path; also asserts the override stays a pure no-op (applied, empty delta, zero warnings) for the owned command. Fails without the gantt export scope entry. Test title: preflight override is scoped to pm-gantt-chart owned command paths

patch.value: gantt export added to the preflight scope (restoring the coverage the global form gave the exporter alias), and the scope is now bound to activation.registrations.commands by a set-equality test plus per-path assertCommandContract, so scope and registered surface cannot drift apart again. Verified: npm test 162/162 pass, release:check exit 0 with 100/100/100 coverage, npx pm health --strict-exit ok.
